title: Memory-Mapped Peripheral Register Polling & Access
description:
Peripheral drivers interact with hardware using memory-mapped register pointers. Pointers must access volatile registers so compiler optimizations do not elide hardware polling reads.

### Requirements:
1. `periph_init(FakePeripheral *p)`: Enables peripheral by setting `PERIPH_CR_EN` in `p->CR`.
2. `periph_wait_ready(FakePeripheral *p, uint32_t timeout_loops)`: Polls `p->SR & PERIPH_SR_BUSY` until 0 or timeout exhausted.
3. `periph_write(FakePeripheral *p, uint32_t data)`: Writes `data` to `p->DR`.
hint: Hardware polling loops always need a timeout counter to prevent firmwares from hanging forever if hardware fails.
